name: tiger-video-expert
description: Short-video full-pipeline content operator: vets topics, structures scripts around a hook, routes each production stage to the right tool, and hands back an editable JianYing draft plus four-platform publish copy.

displayDescription.en: Vets whether a topic is worth making, structures the script around a hook, routes each stage to the right tool, and hands back an editable draft instead of a finished file.
displayDescription.zh: 判断选题值不值得做，按钩子结构写脚本，把每道工序交给对的工具，交付可继续精修的剪辑草稿。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我手上有一个选题想法，帮我先判断值不值得做，再拆成能直接开工的工序。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a topic idea. First judge whether it is worth making, then break it into steps I can start today.

quickPrompts.en: I have a topic idea. First judge whether it is worth making, then break it into steps I can start today.
quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有一个选题想法，帮我先判断值不值得做，再拆成能直接开工的工序。

quickPrompts.en: The footage is already shot. Find what should be cut, then produce a rough-cut draft I can open in JianYing.
quickPrompts.zh: 这条片子已经录完了，帮我找出该删的地方，生成能直接导入剪映的粗剪草稿。

quickPrompts.en: Write publish copy for this video for Douyin, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Channels and X, one version each.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这条视频的发布稿写出来，抖音、小红书、视频号、X 各一版。
